### **Il Canale**

1065 31st St NW,   
Washington, DC 20007  
Phone: (202) 337-4444  
Website: [https://ilcanale.com/](https://ilcanale.com/)

**Vendor Contact:** Alessandro Farrugio (GM) **(703) 347-1999**,   
**Details:** This vendor is used for our food tours occasionally and may become a standard stop in the 2026 season. Contact Alessandro via text to make reservations for food tours. The text should include: date/time, number of guests, and the full order for the guests. Additional information you could include would be the point of contact for the guide assigned to the tour. 

**Standard order schematic for private tour:** 1 Margherita Pizza (cut 8 ways) for every 8 guests. Lunch Menu meatball appetizers come with 2 meatballs \- Standard order is one meatball per guest. Dinner menu meatball appetizers come with 4 meatballs \- Standard order remains 1 meatball per guest. Alcohol option is Montepulcianno Di Abruzzo (Can be purchased by bottle (for 4 guests) or by glass (for 1 guest) or Peroni (1 per guest, not drinking wine)
